name: 2023–2030 Australian Cyber Security Strategy: Horizon 1 Action Plan (2023–2025)
description: Horizon 1 Action Plan (2023–2025) — 2023-2025 edition of 2023–2030 Australian Cyber Security Strategy Action Plan, published by Department of Home Affairs (homeaffairs.gov.au).
